hero.heading: Stopping waste before it reaches the ocean
hero.body: We don't just clean beaches. At the source of ocean pollution, we build sorting stations that intercept the waste before it gets there.

playbook.heading: From cleanups to infrastructure in remote villages
playbook.sub: The same process, copy-pasted from one village to the next
playbook.phase1Body: Hire local women as a cleanup crew, start with beach cleanups and fixed collection points, and prepare the ground for a sorting station.
playbook.phase2Body: Build the basic sorting station — roof, fencing, sorting bays — and grow it into real waste infrastructure for the village.
playbook.phase3Body: Add the incinerator, shredder and compost area, work with local businesses, and move step by step toward breaking even.

taiwan.heading: Back to where it started — the beach cleanup
taiwan.body: A cleanup every month gets more people out of the house and face to face with the problem.
